## Checks

- [ ] `linecheck .` passes, and CI is green
- [ ] Tests cover the change (server: `cargo test`; app: `node --test "src/**/*.test.ts"`; database: `supabase test db`)
- [ ] Docs updated where a fact or a flow changed ([contributing](https://github.com/whereabot/whereabot/blob/main/docs/contributing.md))
- [ ] Privacy: no new stored or logged location or personal data, or [privacy](https://github.com/whereabot/whereabot/blob/main/docs/privacy.md) is updated
